name: striped-pattern
title: Striped Pattern
description: A background of thin diagonal hatch lines for placeholders, caution or editorial panels; static or sliding slowly.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.stripedPattern(q(".mw-striped-pattern"), tl, 0, { width: 28, height: 28, strokeWidth: 2, drift: [14, 0], hold: 6 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Static upstream; drift is this port's option. The docs say 40 px and an offset: the code has 10 px and none (the code wins).
